identity.author: Bedrock-OSS (stirante and contributors)
identity.description: A utility library for Minecraft Bedrock's Script API providing vector math, caching, polyfills, logging, colored chat/JSON, timing, and pulse-based task scheduling.

constraints: Requires attribution: MIT requires retaining the copyright notice

scripts: Vec3, Cache, Polyfill, Logger, ChatColor, ColorJSON, Timings, PulseScheduler and related utility modules

customCapabilities.logging: leveled, tagged logging with scriptevent runtime commands to change level/filter
customCapabilities.scheduling: PulseScheduler family (task/entity/player/unique variants) for distributed per-tick task execution
customCapabilities.caching: caches dimension lookups, height ranges, and block permutations to reduce native API calls

manifestEvidence: README: utility library for Minecraft Bedrock's Script API

strongIndicators: 39 tagged releases, 27 stars, 9 contributors, published on npm
Per-module documentation files (vec3.md, cache.md, logging.md, colorJson.md, scheduler.md, profilingDummy.md)
Concrete usage examples against real @minecraft/server APIs
gaps: Source was not opened or copied; facts are README/documentation-level only

implementationFacts.implementationPattern: General-purpose Script API utility library: 3D vector math, native-call caching, event/scheduling helpers (pulse schedulers keyed by entity/player/unique id), leveled/tagged logging with runtime scriptevent controls, and chat/JSON color formatting
limitations: Not gameplay-content-specific; a supporting utility layer rather than a machine/storage/fluid implementation
performanceCharacteristics: Cache module explicitly reduces costly native dimension/permutation lookups

reviewNotes: Reviewed 2026-09-11 against the public README, root file listing (LICENSE), and release/contributor history.
Only README-level facts were used; no library source code was copied into Hydraulic.
